referee_caveats_inferred: The ALMA role is a distribution weight; all numeric rates depend far more on literature SFRs, magnifications and the assumed f_unobsc = 20 +/- 10% than on the ALMA images.
N_eff uncertainty is a rough 20% rule of thumb rather than propagated from the lens-model posteriors.
Caustic positions come from lens models of mixed quality, some unpublished (in prep.).
No test of the time-delay forecast against measured delays other than known glSNe.

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA processing parameters (in Kamieneski et al. 2024a)
Per-target N_eff derivation and lens models (some in prep.)
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Rate tables can be recomputed from published inputs with negligible data; redoing N_eff needs four ALMA projects' 1 mm images (likely a few GB) plus lens models.
reproducibility.score_reason: Equations, constants and per-target numeric tables are given, so the rate arithmetic is reproducible, but N_eff and delays need lens models and maps from earlier papers and the ALMA processing is not given here.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA is a minor input and the main results depend on lens models and literature SFRs not fully specified in this paper.
